text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'm never, ever, evereverEVER!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Going to let you win!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: What... What was that running just now?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She sees a star—a shooting comet so
bright it
makes the glittering lights of
the Mejiro family
seem like mere haze in
the distance.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ehe... hehe...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin expended so much of her
energy in that
all-out sprint, she doesn't
even have the breath
left to thank the
cheering crowd.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Is that... what a real breakaway looks
like?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: That's the kind of drive you need to win a 2,400-meter race at Tokyo... That was amazing... It was too amazing...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: ...I-nes! I-nes!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A chant begins to swell up from the
stands until it
builds to a deafening roar.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: I-nes! I-nes!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: I-nes! I-nes!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oh. Trainer... Sorry I couldn't win.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... But I'm a racer too. I shouldn't be
happy
for someone else's victory...
choice_data_list: いや、それより強かったな、アイネス
ううん、それより強かったね、アイネス
choice_data_list_en: No, you were stronger than that, Ines.
No, more importantly, Ines was just really strong.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I can't keep being a good person who
keeps
everyone else's interest at heart,
but... But!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I want to be that person just for today
after
getting to see that unbelievable
running!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I'll be right back, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: I-nes! I-nes!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, everybody! Let's cheer even
louder for
her!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I-nes, wahey! I-NES, WAHEY!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Palmer?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: WOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Palmer and Spectators
text_block_list.text: I-NES, WAHEY! I-NES, WAHEY!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer hypes up the crowd even
further
and the chant reaches a fever
pitch. The
celebratory cheers ring out
into infinity.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That night...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see. ☆ If I run the way Ines did
today...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: And my bestie slays the getaway...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: What's up, Helios?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh, nothing. An idea just hit me, and I
was tryna
work it out! ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
It's a pretty god-tier plan, but it could
also be a
total bust! ♪ But enough of
that. C'mon, let's
keep the party going!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Let me just shake up this can of
soda... ☆ Pop the
tab...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Drop in a couple of Menthos candies
and! ★★★
Woohooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whoooaaa, holy crap! Girl, the soda's
spraying
everywhere! Omigo—pffft!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their bubbly after-party to celebrate
the Derby
lasts long into the night.
